Aditi Menon
Accounting Professional | Pimpri-Chinchwad
aditi.menon71@example.com | +91 9948731718

Analytical and detail-oriented accounting professional with a strong background in statutory compliance and ledger management. Demonstrated ability to optimize accounts payable processes, ensure timely TDS and GST filings, and maintain accurate books using Tally. Seeking to contribute reliable financial operations and process improvements; available with a 30 days notice period.

Experience

Medisure — Mar 2026 - Present
Accountant (On-site)
- Managed end-to-end GST filing cycles, reconciled monthly returns, and reduced filing discrepancies by 18% through systematic vendor invoice validation using Tally.
- Processed Accounts Payable for 120+ vendor invoices monthly, improved payment cycle adherence to 95% on-time payments, and implemented three standard invoice checks to cut exceptions by 22%.
- Prepared and submitted timely TDS returns and quarterly TDS certificates, ensuring 100% compliance during internal audits and reducing TDS-related queries by 30%.
- Documented accounting procedures and compliance steps in Confluence to onboard junior staff; shortened new-hire ramp-up time by two weeks.

Swiggy — Apr 2022 - Feb 2026
Accounts Manager (Hybrid)
- Oversaw Accounts Payable operations for regional vendor portfolio, scaling processes to handle a 40% increase in monthly invoice volume while maintaining 92% straight-through processing via Tally-driven templates.
- Led GST compliance across multiple business units, coordinated reconciliations that identified and recovered INR 1.2M in input credit mismatches over 12 months.
- Administered TDS calculations and filings for vendor payments and contractor payouts; implemented monthly reconciliation routines that reduced year-end adjustments by 35%.
- Created and maintained Confluence pages for SOPs and month-end checklists, improving cross-team visibility and decreasing month-end close time by four business days.

Projects
- Invoice Automation Pilot: Designed a vendor invoice validation checklist and Tally import format that reduced manual entry time by 25% and invoice processing errors by 20%.
- GST Credit Recovery Initiative: Led a short-term project to reconcile past GST claims across three divisions, recovering misstated input credits and documenting recovery workflow in Confluence.

Skills
Tally: Tally
Tax & Compliance: GST, TDS
Operations: Accounts Payable
Tools: Confluence

Education
MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore

Notice period: 30 days
